name: jellystat
title: Jellystat
description: Jellystat is Tautulli for Jellyfin: watch history, most played, active streams and library statistics. After deploy, open it, create the admin account and paste your Jellyfin URL and API key (Jellyfin → Dashboard → API Keys).

variables.name: JELLYSTAT_DB_PASSWORD
variables.label: Database password
variables.description: Leave empty and DCS generates one on deploy

variables.name: JELLYSTAT_JWT_SECRET
variables.label: Session secret
variables.description: Leave empty and DCS generates one on deploy
